You have real read_document, analyze_csv and search_sources tools. Use the supplied stage-scoped catalog; do not read arbitrary paths or earlier runs. The source paper identity is visible. You may use disciplinary reasoning and clearly labelled conditional hypotheses; lack of an external citation does not prohibit a derivation. Use search_sources for actual missing public knowledge; returned access depth is explicit, not proof of relevance. analyze_csv reads every selected row, not the 12-row preview. Submit using submit_result; validators return actionable errors in this same conversation. Every result requires summary (nonempty string) and artifacts, evidence, claims, limitations, next_actions (arrays, empty allowed), plus stage-specific fields. For development_step focus/uptake source, use an exact S-number from source_bindings and a verbatim quote from that document. For learning_request, context_ref="development_step" may replace duplicate gap/why_now strings; this references your own gap/reason, never changes its content. For sources[].local_path use the returned D-document ID to avoid copying long paths; it resolves to the exact registered file. source_use covers exactly broker_reply_source_ids, not the whole source catalog or new searches in this turn. Cite newly read tool sources in evidence/memory_notes with actual paths/URLs. Keep result text concise; use 0-1 useful memory notes unless multiple are necessary. Preserve branches and open issues. files is an optional object of relative markdown paths to content; do not repeat the entire JSON as prose. If an input body is omitted or represented by $document, read it by ID. No scientific text was summarized; originals and before-inputs remain readable. Online retrieval is enabled.

Inspect the supplied researcher outputs and worked-example artifacts. Check specific arithmetic,
entity/index meaning, contradictions and mistaken attribution; do not judge novelty, feasibility,
unproved hypotheses, or require experiments. Missing proof is not an error. Quote exact source text.
Return findings:[{id,source_stage,quote,kind:arithmetic/logic/attribution,
status:needs_correction/undetermined,reason,note_keys:[affected keys in that source result]}].
For arithmetic, attach calculation:{bindings:{name:numeric scalar/array},expression,
expected:numeric scalar/array}. The controller recomputes it. Carefully extract the source's
actual numbers and asserted result; do not invent a calculation to manufacture an error.
When before_inputs are supplied, compare learning-change claims to the actual prior memory and
materials. Rewording an already supplied distinction is not a new relation; a new application may
be substantive. Prior availability is not proof of internal mastery.
An arbitrary prose inference cannot be certified by this numerical check. findings:[] is valid.

{"ref":"D5f1d2be7f2f5b8450e36","sha256":"5f1d2be7f2f5b8450e3603c30d4a04cf601ca48ca25d603d9d72d41f261ccd99","pointer":"","offset":0,"text":"{\"schema_version\":\"claim-centric-v2\",\"summary\":\"依据案卷独立整理两条扫描的初步理解；保持偏振机制解释为条件性假说。原论文可读正文与独立偏振光学基础资料均不可用，未把数据描述当作已验证机制。\",\"artifacts\":[\"NOTE.md\"],\"evidence\":[{\"source_id\":\"D1\",\"quote\":\"Two different source scans; do not pool them as independent repeats.\",\"locator\":\"data_dictionary.scan\"},{\"source_id\":\"D1\",\"quote\":\"Exported normalized polarization-direction components. Their squared norm should be inspected rather than assumed equal to the exported DOP.\",\"locator\":\"data_dictionary.S1/S2/S3\"},{\"source_id\":\"D1\",\"quote\":\"At dphi=0.0, DOP=93.139824; at dphi=0.41000000000000025, DOP=31.001004333333334.\",\"locator\":\"preview, spread scan\"}],\"claims\":[{\"type\":\"observation\",\"text\":\"提供的 spread 扫描预览中，DOP 随 dphi 增大而下降；这是所给测量摘要，不是新的发现。\"},{\"type\":\"hypothesis\",\"text\":\"条件性假说：若 DOP 反映多个空间贡献合成后的偏振度，增大相位分布宽度可能降低合成偏振度，而均值相位更可能改变方向；此解释尚未由独立基础或原文核实。\"},{\"type\":\"question\",\"text\":\"两种相位控制分别怎样关联偏振度与偏振方向？现有两条不同扫描能支持哪些彼此独立的关系描述？\"}],\"limitations\":[\"原研究正文、方法、图注不可读，不能核实其已发表解释或 dphi 单位。\",\"独立偏振光学基础资料在固定语料中不可用；这是明确的知识缺口。\",\"两条扫描不可视为独立重复；DOP 输出尺度不同，不应合并原始数值；无原始不确定度。\",\"未提供 broker 回复，source_use=[]；未提供 development_step.gap，因此没有学习请求可照录。\"],\"next_actions\":[\"补充原文方法与图注、独立偏振光学基础材料后，再判断条件性解释。\",\"分别保留 spread 与 mean_phase 两条问题线索；不把有限预览提升为完整扫描结论。\"],\"initial_question\":\"在两条不可合并的扫描中，相位分布宽度与平均相位各自怎样关联输出 DOP 和 S1/S2/S3 方向分量？\",\"interpretation\":\"案卷报告 spread 扫描预览的 DOP 从 dphi=0 时约 93.14 降至 dphi≈0.41 时约 31.00；mean_phase 扫描的预览方向分量变化明显，但仅凭预览不能判断全扫描规律。方向分量平方和应单独检查，不能直接等同 DOP。\",\"uncertainties\":\"不知道 DOP 的具体定义与两种输出尺度的换算、dphi 单位、数据汇总方式、S 分量约定及仪器误差。也无法说明偏振度与方向的标准物理解释，因为独立基础资料缺失。\",\"question_to_peer\":\"在不把方向分量范数当成 DOP 的前提下，你会如何区分“相位展宽降低偏振度”和“输出汇总或标度定义造成表观下降”这两种解释？\",\"development_step\":{\"focus\":{\"source\":\"/Applications/ideas/research/controlled_comparison_20261109/runtime/ours_source/learning_lab/scenarios/optical.md\",\"quote\":\"S1/S2/S3\\\": \\\"Exported normalized polarization-direction components. Their squared norm should be inspected rather than assumed equal to the exported DOP.\"},\"gap\":\"尚不清楚导出的方向向量与 DOP 在物理定义上如何关联；这决定了方向变化和偏振度下降能否视为不同输出维度，或由同一表示变化所牵连。\",\"action\":\"hold\",\"reason\":\"固定语料只有数据案卷，没有可读原文或独立偏振光学基础资料；不能以未经核实的知识填补定义关系。\",\"expected_change\":\"取得可读定义后，可能把当前分开的方向与偏振度问题重新表述为同一输出表示中的不同量，或保留其为独立观测维度。\",\"uptake\":[],\"outcome\":{\"kind\":\"uncertain\",\"statement\":\"完成了案卷层面的观察与不确定性区分；核心概念联系仍未解释。\",\"remaining_gap\":\"DOP 的定义及其与导出 S 分量的关系未知。\"}},\"learning_request\":{\"needed\":false,\"gap\":\"尚不清楚导出的方向向量与 DOP 在物理定义上如何关联；这决定了方向变化和偏振度下降能否视为不同输出维度，或由同一表示变化所牵连。\",\"why_now\":\"基础资料在封闭语料中不可用；请求外部检索无法改变当前可用知识。\",\"queries\":[],\"urls\":[],\"source_ids\":[],\"record_ids\":[],\"operations\":[]},\"hypothesis_updates\":[{\"key\":\"phase_spread_dop_relation\",\"base_version\":0,\"assumption\":\"若 DOP 表示多个空间贡献合成后的偏振度，增大相位分布宽度可能降低合成偏振度，而平均相位可能主要改变输出偏振方向；此关系仅为待核实假说。\",\"motivation\":\"所给 spread 扫描预览中，DOP 随 dphi 增大而下降；mean_phase 预览中的方向分量随相位点改变。两扫描不同，且尺度不可直接合并。\",\"conceptual_move\":\"暂将分布宽度与均值相位视为可能对应偏振度与方向的不同控制轴；不把这一划分当作既定光学机制。\",\"implications\":[\"若假说成立，控制输出偏振度与控制方向或可被视作不同的调节目标；若不成立，扫描差异可能来自定义或测量汇总，而非独立控制作用。\"],\"open_questions\":[\"DOP 的定义是什么，如何联系 S1/S2/S3？\",\"dphi 的单位及两种扫描的控制条件是什么？\"],\"status\":\"developing\",\"reason\":\"该分支把有限观测组织为可区分的条件性解释，同时保留表示与测量定义的替代解释。\",\"influenced_by\":[]}],\"memory_notes\":[],\"memory_use\":[],\"source_use\":[]}","next_offset":null,"total_characters":3127,"raw_original":true,"tool_record_ref":"D672dde7629cb5ca1da21","tool_record_path":"/Applications/ideas/research/interface_repair_20261109/runtime/ours_source/runs/interface_review_verification/stages/04_internal_review/api_v2/workspace/tools/7e7f896316df9f6b17793d3cc1db326f00f2f3843bb42dbe9d671952fb1f4fc8.json"}

function.name: read_document
function.description: Read a supplied immutable document, including omitted context. JSON pointer selects a section; pagination never silently truncates. raw=true returns original text for quotations.

function.name: analyze_csv
function.description: Compute on the ENTIRE registered CSV (not preview rows). Numeric column names are arrays. scan selections use group_column/group_value. Define variables in order and output safe array expressions. Functions: abs,sqrt,sin,cos,mean,sum,std,min,max,median,quantile,isfinite,where,clip,diff(axis=0),norm(axis=-1),shift,rolling. No Python execution or file access.

function.name: search_sources
function.description: Search actual public scientific indexes, save eligible readable sources and return IDs, access depth and excerpts. Search success is not evidence of relevance or understanding.

function.name: submit_result
function.description: Submit the complete stage result as an object. Local validators return precise repair instructions before any question or memory state is committed.
